+    "gemini": ("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai", "GEMINI_API_KEY"),
+    "openrouter": ("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"),
+    "ollama": ("http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1", ""),
+    "lmstudio": ("http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1", ""),
+    "compatible": ("", ""),
+}
+JSON_LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
+AUDIO_LIMIT = 32 * 1024 * 1024
+
+
+class ProviderError(RuntimeError):
+    """An actionable provider failure, without response bodies or credentials."""
+
+
+def is_loopback(host: str | None) -> bool:
+    """Recognize literal loopback addresses without DNS, e.g. 127.0.0.1."""
+    if host == "localhost":
+        return True
+    try:
+        return ipaddress.ip_address(host or "").is_loopback
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def checked_url(url: str, *, allow_query: bool = False) -> str:
+    """Allow HTTPS or local HTTP; reject credentials and query-string secrets."""
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    if not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password or (parsed.query and not allow_query) or parsed.fragment:
+        raise ProviderError("API URL must have a host and no credentials, query, or fragment")
+    if parsed.scheme != "https" and not (parsed.scheme == "http" and is_loopback(parsed.hostname)):
+        raise ProviderError("API URL must use HTTPS (HTTP is allowed only on loopback)")
+    return url.rstrip("/")
+
+
+class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
+    """Do not forward authorization headers to a redirect destination."""
+
+    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
+        raise ProviderError(f"API redirected (HTTP {code}); configure its final URL explicitly")
+
+
+def request_bytes(url: str, body: bytes | None, headers: dict, timeout: float,
+                  limit: int = JSON_LIMIT) -> bytes:
+    """Make one bounded request; never retry a potentially billable operation."""
+    request = urllib.request.Request(checked_url(url, allow_query=True), data=body, headers=headers)
+    try:
+        # A system HTTP proxy must not silently turn loopback inference into remote traffic.
+        handlers = [NoRedirect()]
+        if is_loopback(urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).hostname):
+            handlers.append(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
+        with urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers).open(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
+            data = response.read(limit + 1)
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        # Provider bodies can echo prompts, audio metadata, or even credentials.
+        raise ProviderError(f"API HTTP {exc.code}; check endpoint, model, credentials and quota") from exc
+    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
+        raise ProviderError("API connection failed or timed out; check endpoint and network") from exc
+    if len(data) > limit:
+        raise ProviderError(f"API response exceeds the {limit}-byte limit")
+    return data
+
+
+def request_json(url: str, payload: dict | None, headers: dict, timeout: float) -> dict:
+    """Read a JSON object, e.g. request_json(url, payload, headers, 60)."""
+    data = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode()
+    result = request_bytes(url, data, {"Content-Type": "application/json", **headers}, timeout)
+    try:
+        decoded = json.loads(result)
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ProviderError("API returned invalid JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(decoded, dict):
+        raise ProviderError("API response must be a JSON object")
+    return decoded
+
+
+def key_headers(env_name: str, *, required: bool = True, header: str = "Authorization") -> dict:
+    """Read only the chosen credential, e.g. key_headers('GEMINI_API_KEY')."""
+    key = os.environ.get(env_name, "") if env_name else ""
+    if required and not key:
+        raise ProviderError(f"{env_name or 'API key variable'} is not set; run omarchy-voice setup")
+    if not key:
+        return {}
+    if any(char in key for char in "\r\n"):
+        raise ProviderError("API key contains an invalid newline")
+    return {header: f"Bearer {key}" if header == "Authorization" else key}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BrainEndpoint:
+    base_url: str
+    model: str
+    key_env: str
+
+
+def brain_endpoint(config) -> BrainEndpoint:
+    """Resolve the text planner independently from the integrated voice model."""
+    if not isinstance(config.brain_provider, str) or config.brain_provider not in BRAIN_PRESETS:
+        raise ProviderError(f"unknown brain provider: {config.brain_provider!r}")
+    default_url, default_env = BRAIN_PRESETS[config.brain_provider]
+    base = checked_url(config.brain_base_url or default_url)
+    if config.brain_provider == "openai":
+        default_env = config.api_key_env  # preserve legacy custom key variables
+    if config.brain_base_url and base != default_url.rstrip("/"):
+        default_env = ""  # a custom destination requires explicit credential selection
+    key_env = config.brain_api_key_env or default_env
+    model = config.brain_model or (config.planner_model if config.brain_provider == "openai" else "")
+    if not isinstance(model, str) or not model.strip():
+        raise ProviderError("brain.model must not be empty")
+    return BrainEndpoint(base, model, key_env)
+
+
+def chat_completion(messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict], config) -> dict:
+    """Use the compatible tool-calling API, preserving provider metadata."""
+    endpoint = brain_endpoint(config)
+    if config.brain_provider == "ollama":
+        return ollama_completion(messages, tools, config, endpoint)
+    protected = {"model", "messages", "tools", "tool_choice", "stream"}
+    if protected.intersection(config.brain_extra):
+        raise ProviderError("brain.extra cannot override model, messages, tools, tool_choice or stream")
+    payload = {"model": endpoint.model, "messages": messages, "tools": tools,
+               "tool_choice": "auto", **config.brain_extra}
+    headers = key_headers(endpoint.key_env, required=bool(endpoint.key_env))
+    return request_json(endpoint.base_url + "/chat/completions", payload, headers, config.brain_timeout)
+
+
+def ollama_root(config) -> str:
+    """Use the same Ollama server for inference and explicit model management."""
+    endpoint = brain_endpoint(config)
+    return endpoint.base_url.removesuffix("/v1")
+
+
+def ollama_messages(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    """Convert only transport details, retaining thinking and tool history."""
+    result, names = [], {}
+    for message in copy.deepcopy(messages):
+        for call in message.get("tool_calls", []):
+            names[call.get("id", "")] = call["function"]["name"]
+            arguments = call["function"].get("arguments", {})
+            if isinstance(arguments, str):
+                call["function"]["arguments"] = json.loads(arguments)
+        if message.get("role") == "tool":
+            message["tool_name"] = names.get(message.pop("tool_call_id", ""), "")
+        result.append(message)
+    return result
+
+
+def ollama_completion(messages, tools, config, endpoint) -> dict:
+    """Adapt native Ollama tools; explicitly size context for the desktop manifest."""
+    protected = {"model", "messages", "tools", "stream", "options", "keep_alive"}
+    if protected.intersection(config.brain_extra):
+        raise ProviderError("brain.extra conflicts with managed Ollama request fields")
+    payload = {"model": endpoint.model, "messages": ollama_messages(messages), "tools": tools,
+               "stream": False, "keep_alive": config.brain_keep_alive,
+               "options": {"num_ctx": config.brain_context}, **config.brain_extra}
+    data = request_json(ollama_root(config) + "/api/chat", payload,
+                        key_headers(endpoint.key_env, required=bool(endpoint.key_env)), config.brain_timeout)
+    message = data.get("message")
+    if not isinstance(message, dict):
+        raise ProviderError("Ollama did not return an assistant message")
+    for index, call in enumerate(message.get("tool_calls") or []):
+        call.setdefault("id", f"ollama_{len(messages)}_{index}")
+        call.setdefault("type", "function")
+        if isinstance(call.get("function", {}).get("arguments"), dict):
+            call["function"]["arguments"] = json.dumps(call["function"]["arguments"])
+    return {"choices": [{"message": message}], "usage": {
+        "prompt_tokens": data.get("prompt_eval_count", 0), "completion_tokens": data.get("eval_count", 0)}}

+"""Interactive provider setup; preserve settings, back up files and isolate secrets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import dataclasses
+import getpass
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import tomllib
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from . import config as cfg
+from .models import manage, native_command
+from .providers import BRAIN_PRESETS, ProviderError, checked_url
+
+
+def toml_value(value) -> str:
+    """Encode configuration values, not executable Python or shell strings."""
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return "true" if value else "false"
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return repr(value)
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return "[" + ", ".join(toml_value(item) for item in value) + "]"
+    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
+        return value.isoformat()
+    raise ProviderError(f"Cannot preserve TOML value of type {type(value).__name__}")
+
+
+def dump_toml(data: dict, prefix: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> str:
+    """Serialize parsed TOML; values survive, comments are kept in the backup."""
+    lines = []
